title: Create a Student Marksheet with Formulas
description: Build a complete student marksheet using SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN, COUNT functions and cell formatting in Excel.
objective: Students will create a formatted student marksheet in Excel, use essential functions (SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN, COUNT, IF) to calculate totals, averages, and pass/fail results, and apply cell formatting to present the data professionally.

steps.title: Set Up the Marksheet Structure
steps.instructions:
Open Microsoft Excel and create a new blank workbook.

1. In cell **A1**, type the title: **TechPath Institute — Student Marksheet 2026**
2. Select cells A1 to J1, then click **Merge & Center** (Home tab > Alignment group). Make the title **Bold**, font size **14**, and apply a **dark blue background** with **white text**.
3. In **Row 3**, enter the following headers:
   - A3: `Roll No.`
   - B3: `Student Name`
   - C3: `Hindi`
   - D3: `English`
   - E3: `Mathematics`
   - F3: `Science`
   - G3: `Computer`
   - H3: `Total`
   - I3: `Average`
   - J3: `Result`
4. Format the header row: **Bold**, **Center-aligned**, light blue background color.
5. Adjust column widths so all headers are fully visible (double-click the column border to auto-fit).

steps.title: Enter Student Data
steps.instructions:
Enter marks for 6 students starting from Row 4. Use marks between 25 and 98 for each subject.

| Roll No. | Name | Hindi | English | Maths | Science | Computer |
|----------|------|-------|---------|-------|---------|----------|
| 2601 | Rahul Sharma | 72 | 85 | 68 | 78 | 90 |
| 2602 | Priya Verma | 88 | 92 | 95 | 91 | 87 |
| 2603 | Amit Patel | 45 | 52 | 38 | 41 | 55 |
| 2604 | Sneha Gupta | 78 | 80 | 82 | 85 | 88 |
| 2605 | Ananya Singh | 92 | 88 | 90 | 94 | 96 |
| 2606 | Vikram Joshi | 30 | 28 | 25 | 32 | 35 |

After entering the data:
- Apply **borders** to all data cells (Home > Borders > All Borders).
- Apply **Number format** to all mark cells (no decimal places).
- Center-align the Roll No. column.

steps.title: Add Formulas for Total, Average, and Result
steps.instructions:
Now write the formulas to calculate results.

**Total Marks (Column H):**
1. Click on cell **H4**.
2. Type: `=SUM(C4:G4)` and press Enter.
3. This adds all 5 subject marks for Rahul.
4. Select H4, grab the **Fill Handle** (small black cross at bottom-right corner), and drag down to H9 to fill the formula for all students.

**Average Marks (Column I):**
1. Click on cell **I4**.
2. Type: `=AVERAGE(C4:G4)` and press Enter.
3. Drag the Fill Handle down to I9.
4. Format column I to show **1 decimal place** (right-click > Format Cells > Number > 1 decimal place).

**Result (Column J):**
1. Click on cell **J4**.
2. Type: `=IF(I4>=33,"Pass","Fail")` and press Enter.
3. Drag the Fill Handle down to J9.
4. Manually apply **green background** to cells showing "Pass" and **red background** to cells showing "Fail".

steps.title: Add Summary Statistics
steps.instructions:
Below the student data, add summary calculations.

1. In cell **A11**, type: `Highest Marks`
2. In cell **A12**, type: `Lowest Marks`
3. In cell **A13**, type: `Class Average`
4. In cell **A14**, type: `Total Students`
5. Make all four labels **Bold**.

Now enter the formulas:

**Highest Marks (Row 11):**
- Cell C11: `=MAX(C4:C9)`
- Copy this formula to D11, E11, F11, G11 (or drag the Fill Handle across).

**Lowest Marks (Row 12):**
- Cell C12: `=MIN(C4:C9)`
- Copy across to D12 through G12.

**Class Average (Row 13):**
- Cell C13: `=AVERAGE(C4:C9)`
- Copy across to D13 through G13.
- Format Row 13 with 1 decimal place.

**Total Students (Row 14):**
- Cell C14: `=COUNT(C4:C9)`
- This should return 6.

Apply borders and a **light yellow background** to the summary section.

steps.title: Final Formatting and Save
steps.instructions:
Apply finishing touches to make the marksheet look professional.

1. **Select all data** (A1 to J14) and apply **outer thick border** (Home > Borders > Thick Box Border).
2. **Freeze the header row:** Go to View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Top Row (or click on cell A4 first, then View > Freeze Panes > Freeze Panes to freeze rows 1-3).
3. **Adjust column widths** one final time so everything is neatly visible.
4. **Add a footer:** Go to Insert > Header & Footer. In the center footer section, type: `TechPath Institute — CCC Batch 2026`
5. **Set Print Area:** Select A1:J14, go to Page Layout > Print Area > Set Print Area.
6. **Print Preview:** Press Ctrl + P to verify the marksheet looks correct.
7. **Save** the file as `Student_Marksheet.xlsx` (Ctrl + S).

Verify your work:
- Click on formula cells to confirm they reference the correct ranges.
- Check that Vikram Joshi shows "Fail" (his average should be below 33).
- Confirm that MAX, MIN, AVERAGE, and COUNT show correct values.
